title: General Catalyst commits $5B to India over five years
description: The pledge marks a sharp jump from General Catalyst's earlier $500 million–$1 billion India earmark.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Google’s new Gemini Pro model has record benchmark scores — again
description: Gemini 3.1 Pro promises a Google LLM capable of handling more complex forms of work.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Nvidia deepens early-stage push into India’s AI startup ecosystem
description: Nvidia is working with investors, nonprofits, and venture firms to build earlier ties with India's fast-growing AI founder ecosystem.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Why these startup CEOs don’t think AI will replace human roles
description: The CEOs of Read AI and Lucidya told TechCrunch at Web Summit Qatar that they see AI tools replacing tasks, rather than workers.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: YouTube’s latest experiment brings its conversational AI tool to TVs
description: YouTube is testing conversational AI on smart TVs, allowing viewers to ask the assistant questions related to the video they're watching on the big screen.
author: Lauren Forristal

title: Reddit is testing a new AI search feature for shopping
description: A small group of users in the U.S. will start to see search results that include interactive product carousels with pricing, images, and direct where-to-buy links.
author: Aisha Malik

title: All the important news from the ongoing India AI Impact Summit
description: India is hosting a four-day AI Summit this week that will be attended by executives from major AI labs and Big Tech, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Nvidia, Microsoft, Google, and Cloudflare, as well as heads of state.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: OpenAI reportedly finalizing $100B deal at more than $850B valuation
description: OpenAI is reportedly getting close to closing a $100 billion deal, with backers including Amazon, Nvidia, SoftBank, and Microsoft. The deal would value the ChatGPT-maker at $850 billion.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Reload wants to give your AI agents a shared memory
description: Reload announces a $2.275 million raise in a round led by Anthemis and the launch of its first AI employee, Epic.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis

title: OpenAI, Reliance partner to add AI search to JioHotstar
description: The rollout includes two-way integration that surfaces streaming links directly inside ChatGPT.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Co-founders behind Reface and Prisma join hands to improve on-device model inference with Mirai
description: Mirai raised a $10 million seed to improve how AI models run on devices like smartphones and laptops.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: For open-source programs, AI coding tools are a mixed blessing
description: AI coding tools have enabled a flood of bad code that threatens to overwhelm many projects. Building new features is easier but maintaining them is just as hard.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Altman and Amodei share a moment of awkwardness at India’s big AI summit
description: When Prime Minister Narendra Modi prompted speakers at the event to join hands and raise them in a show of unity, all executives on stage obliged, except OpenAI's Sam Altman and Anthropic's Dario Amodei, who held their hands conspicuously apart.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Freeform raises $67M Series B to scale up laser AI manufacturing
description: “I think we're the only quote-unquote manufacturing company out there that has H200 clusters in a data center on site."
author: Tim Fernholz

title: Reliance unveils $110B AI investment plan as India ramps up tech ambitions
description: Reliance has begun building multi-gigawatt AI data centers in Jamnagar, with more than 120 MW of capacity expected to come online in 2026.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: OpenAI taps Tata for 100MW AI data center capacity in India, eyes 1GW
description: OpenAI also plans to expand its presence in India with new offices in Mumbai and Bengaluru later this year.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: OpenAI deepens India push with Pine Labs fintech partnership
description: OpenAI moves beyond ChatGPT in India with a Pine Labs deal targeting enterprise payments and AI-driven commerce.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Is your startup’s check engine light on? Google Cloud’s VP explains what to do
description: Startup founders are being pushed to move faster than ever, using AI while facing tighter funding, rising infrastructure costs, and more pressure to show real traction early. Cloud credits, access to GPUs, and foundation models have made it easier to get started, but those early infrastructure choices can have unforeseen consequences once startups move beyond […]
author: Theresa Loconsolo

title: Google Cloud’s VP for startups on reading your ‘check engine light’ before it’s too late
description: Startup founders are being pushed to move faster than ever, using AI while facing tighter funding, rising infrastructure costs, and more pressure to show real traction early. Cloud credits, access to GPUs, and foundation models have made it easier to get started, but those early infrastructure choices can have unforeseen consequences once startups move beyond […]
author: Rebecca Bellan, Theresa Loconsolo

title: Amazon halts Blue Jay robotics project after less than six months
description: Amazon said Blue Jay's core tech will be used for other robotics projects and the employees who worked on it were moved to other projects.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Google adds music-generation capabilities to the Gemini app
description: Users will be able to use text, images, and videos as a reference to generate music.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Kana emerges from stealth with $15M to build flexible AI agents for marketers
description: Kana, a new AI marketing startup from the founders of Rapt and Krux, has raised $15 million to build customizable, agent-based marketing tools.
author: Ram Iyer

title: Microsoft says Office bug exposed customers’ confidential emails to Copilot AI
description: Microsoft said the bug meant that its Copilot AI chatbot was reading and summarizing paying customers' confidential emails, bypassing data protection policies.
author: Zack Whittaker

title: OpenAI pushes into higher education as India seeks to scale AI skills
description: OpenAI says its India education partnerships aim to reach more than 100,000 students, faculty and staff over the next year.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: World Labs lands $200M from Autodesk to bring world models into 3D workflows
description: The partnership will see the two companies exploring how World Labs’ models can work alongside Autodesk’s tools, and vice versa, starting with a focus on entertainment use cases.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: India’s Sarvam wants to bring its AI models to feature phones, cars and smart glasses
description: The company is using edge models that take up only megabytes of space, can run on most phones with existing processors, and can work offline.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Indian AI lab Sarvam’s new models are a major bet on the viability of open-source AI
description: The new lineup includes 30-billion and 105-billion parameter models; a text-to-speech model; a speech-to-text model; and a vision model to parse documents.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Apple is reportedly cooking up a trio of AI wearables
description: As the AI hardware space heats up, the iPhone maker has multiple smart products in development.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Anthropic releases Sonnet 4.6
description: Anthropic has released a new version of its mid-size Sonnet model, keeping pace with the company's four-month update cycle.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Mistral AI buys Koyeb in first acquisition to back its cloud ambitions
description: Mistral AI has agreed to buy Koyeb, a Paris-based startup that simplifies AI app deployment at scale and manages the infrastructure behind it.
author: Anna Heim
